# Unit test for function rounded_avg
def test_rounded_avg():
    # Test when m < n, should return -1
    assert rounded_avg(7, 5) == -1
    assert rounded_avg(10, 1) == -1
    assert rounded_avg(100, 50) == -1

    # Test normal cases
    assert rounded_avg(1, 5) == "0b11"       # avg = 3
    assert rounded_avg(7, 13) == "0b1010"    # avg = 10
    assert rounded_avg(10, 20) == "0b1111"   # avg = 15
    assert rounded_avg(20, 33) == "0b11010"  # avg = 26.5 -> rounds to 26

    # Test single-element ranges
    assert rounded_avg(0, 0) == "0b0"        # avg = 0
    assert rounded_avg(1, 1) == "0b1"        # avg = 1
    assert rounded_avg(5, 5) == "0b101"      # avg = 5

    # Test rounding up case
    assert rounded_avg(1, 2) == "0b10"       # avg = 1.5 -> rounds to 2

    print("All tests passed!")


# Run the test
test_rounded_avg()
